GM 3064 Universal Charger with 240V Power Output – International Travel Adapter for 150+ Countries

The GM 3064 Universal Charger with 240V Power Output is the perfect travel essential for modern globetrotters, business travelers, and digital nomads. Designed to work seamlessly across continents, this international travel adapter supports power sockets in over 150+ countries including the US, UK, EU, and Australia. Whether you are charging smartphones, tablets, cameras, or other USB-powered devices, the GM 3064 ensures safe, efficient, and reliable charging anywhere in the world.

Equipped with advanced charging ports, this universal charger features a Type C output of 3.1Amp and a Type A output of 2.1Amp, allowing you to charge multiple devices simultaneously. The compact design and built-in LED indicator make it easy to monitor power status, even in low-light environments such as hotel rooms or airports.

Universal Compatibility for Global Travel

The is engineered to support a wide voltage range up to 240V power output, making it suitable for most international electrical standards. From North America to Europe and Asia-Pacific regions, this universal charger eliminates the need to carry multiple adapters. It works flawlessly with popular destinations such as the USA, UK, EU countries, Australia, Japan, Singapore, and more.

  • Supports US, UK, EU, and AUS plug standards
  • Compatible with sockets in over 150 countries worldwide
  • Ideal for international business trips and vacations
  • No voltage conversion required for supported devices

Fast & Safe Dual USB Charging

The allows you to power two devices at the same time without compromising charging speed. The Type C port delivers up to 3.1Amp, making it suitable for fast charging modern smartphones and tablets, while the Type A port provides 2.1Amp for standard USB devices such as power banks, Bluetooth accessories, and cameras.

  • USB Type C – 3.1Amp fast charging output
  • USB Type A – 2.1Amp standard charging output
  • Charge smartphones, tablets, earbuds, and more
  • Smart power distribution for device safety

LED Indicator & Compact Travel-Friendly Design

A built-in LED indicator clearly shows when the charger is connected to power, helping users avoid accidental unplugging or incorrect connections. The compact and lightweight design of the ensures it fits easily into backpacks, luggage, or laptop bags, making it a must-have travel accessory. Crafted with high-quality materials, the adapter offers enhanced durability and long-lasting performance. Its ergonomic structure ensures a secure fit in international sockets, reducing the risk of loose connections during use.

Why Choose?

  • 240V power output suitable for international travel
  • Dual USB ports – Type C (3.1Amp) and Type A (2.1Amp)
  • LED power indicator for easy monitoring
  • Works in 150+ countries including US, UK, EU, and AUS
  • Compact, lightweight, and travel-ready design
  • Trusted GM quality with built-in safety features

Ideal Use Cases

The is ideal for international travelers, corporate professionals, students studying abroad, and frequent flyers. Whether you are staying in hotels, attending global conferences, or exploring new destinations, this keeps your devices powered without hassle. Choose the for a reliable, efficient, and globally compatible charging solution that meets modern travel demands while following international safety and performance standards.
